title: GATE CS Mock Test 1 - Algorithms & Data Structures

questions.questionText: What is the worst-case time complexity of QuickSort?
questions.explanation: Worst-case occurs when the pivot is always the smallest or largest element, leading to O(n^2).

questions.questionText: What is the minimum number of queues required to implement a stack?
questions.explanation: Two queues are needed to simulate LIFO behavior.
